title: THE GUIDE · what you can say here, and what happens
kept_by: the kernel — the same words on every door; Fable keeps it current with each spoonful

sections.title: The chat
sections.lead: Type to the crew. A reply always arrives whole. Esc closes one thing at a time.

entries.does: A thought: the librarian answers with its tools; every body it needs is asked.

entries.say: echo, say the word HERON once
entries.does: A name at the head sends the ask to that body alone.

entries.say: librarian, remember that I went to the trailer today
entries.does: The librarian keeps the words in the Record. Ask later: "what do you remember about the trailer?"

entries.say: between 9am and noon, what did I ask?
entries.does: Sets the time window the crew reads from; "since yesterday" works too.

entries.say: follow up on this by counting the asks
entries.does: A child of the origin last opened in the Analyzer.
The Master Mind In The Loop reads the canon and says what a change touches; every hold offers "expected impact?".
A table of every ask, act and reply with its chain of who acted for whom, signed by the kernel; two downloads beneath it, JSON and CSV.
Your worldlines, newest first, each with its short version; a new session archives the old one — nothing is deleted.
This guide, opened to where you are.

sections.title: The kind of an ask
sections.lead: The chip under the composer reads the kind from your words; one click flips it.

entries.does: One answer, now.
Work the crew owns until it is done; the Analyzer shows it under its origin.

entries.say: keep this world resilient: when a watch goes red, get it green
entries.does: An intention — a standing purpose that wakes on what it watches; it appears in the Analyzer with its stop.

entries.say: echo, every 5 seconds, say the time, please
entries.does: A cadence: the intention runs on the clock; "echo, stop" rests it, "echo, restart intention 'every 5 seconds'" stands it again.

sections.title: When the kernel asks "Are you sure?"
sections.lead: A consequential act holds until you decide. Cancel is the default and has the focus; Yes needs a deliberate click.

entries.does: Nothing runs; the hold is recorded as cancelled.
The act runs on your word and wears proof L2; a grave act asks for your authenticator's code instead ("enroll my authenticator" once).
MITL says who and what the act touches before you decide.
A keeper never retires, assigns, refills or re-pins alone — it proposes here and you cut; a proposal whose reason has passed withdraws itself.

sections.title: The Crew
sections.lead: Every body in this world, both sides: what it served and the job it runs. Beneath the bodies stands the shelf.

entries.say: what services are here? · show the tools · show the LLMs
entries.does: The shelf, from the registry: every tool, MCP server, store, source and LLM on one ladder — registered → versioned → healthy | unhealthy → retired.

entries.say: check the services · check the minds
entries.does: Every standing service probed by its kind; an LLM answers a one-token ping through the gateway.

entries.say: retire the weather tool · restore the weather tool
entries.does: Retire holds at the interlock; restore is a new fact. Retired is dormancy, never deletion.

entries.say: toolkeeper, add the MCP server at <command or URL>
entries.does: The server and its tools land on the shelf as identities; its secrets by env NAME only.

entries.say: stablekeeper, add the LLM ollama gemma3:270m as gemma
entries.does: An LLM wherever it lives — anthropic · openrouter · ollama · openai · compatible — becomes a stall in the Stable and an entry in the gateway; held for your yes.

entries.say: assign librarian to gemma · assign librarian to gemma for fast work · unassign librarian
entries.does: Which LLM a body uses, for all its work or one class of work (fast · standard · deep); the card says "LLM: …" and why.
A body's allowance for this window and what it has spent; a refill holds at the interlock — real spending.

entries.say: schedule an ask for librarian… (on its card)
entries.does: A standing duty on the clock, shown on the card's job side; "rest it" stops it.

sections.title: The Monitoring
sections.lead: The operating state of this world, live: the rails, the bodies, the asks, the watches, THE STABLE, the HEALTH CHECKS.

entries.does: The monitor agent proposes a watch — a hold you cut; a watch is RED while its condition holds and turns in the chat.
A watch over the farm: spend today, thoughts per minute, LLMs standing, bodies out of fuel.
What must be true of this world, read from the ground now: nine rows, each holds or BROKEN with its words; read every 30 seconds.

entries.say: run the harness against the librarian now
entries.does: The golden cases against a body's LLM; a failing run escalates to the chat.

sections.title: The Analyzer
sections.lead: Everything born in the chat, by origin: intentions, objectives, in flight and done. Every row is a door.

entries.does: Its tree in words; an objective's row puts the chat in focus on it.
A grave act: your code, then a declared master's click; the intention rests, recorded, never deleted.
The reverse, through the same ladder; it "stands again".

sections.title: Memory, sessions and the export
sections.lead: The kernel never forgets: every word acquired is kept verbatim with its lineage; a correction is a sibling, never an overwrite.

entries.say: what do you remember about the trailer?
entries.does: Recall, stemmed and ranked; the librarian answers from the Record, word for word.
Each session's short version — the digest — written from the Record alone; the same on every door.

entries.say: export compliance for this session · export compliance for today
entries.does: Signed by the kernel's own self (did:orreth:kernel:…); a stranger can verify the chain and the signature.
Governed erasure: every version leaves; a tombstone keeps the hashes; the digests that cited it are rebuilt.
